text:
Maria Gonzalez: morning async — quick pulse from me

what I did: onboarded llama-3-small-q to staging, ran full eval sweep for summarization + QA sets. 
blockers: seeing a repro regression on summarization set B (ROUGE-1 down ~3.8). seems prompt-dependent when we include the long metadata header. :thinking:
plan/today: bisect prompt variants, try toggling prefix caching and rerun small eval + sanity smoke on dedicated42. tagging @Samir for KV-cache sanity check.

Samir Patel: looking now. saw a different failure earlier with long prefix + kv-ttl mismatch. I raised a quick PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/kv-cache/pulls/2345 — simple guard for stale cache entries. gonna run the unit tests then smoke on staging.

Ana Li: heads-up — I added a prompt set (summ-set-b-2026-03) with trimmed metadata variants. if you want to run, it's in s3://redwood-evals/prompt-sets/summ-set-b-2026-03.jsonl. also updated eval harness to log prompt length distribution.

Ryan Cho: FYI I pushed a config tweak to the runner that limits batch accumulation for requests > 1k tokens (PR #778). Might reduce weird interleaving when prefix is long. rolling out to staging in 1h. :gear:

Maria Gonzalez: nice. after @Samir PR merges can someone kick off a focused eval: only summ-set-b trimmed vs full, model=llama-3-small-q, seeds 1..3, 1k-token prefix. tag me when results land.

eval-bot: job queued: eval-run/1942006790 (llama-3-small-q | summ-set-b-2026-03 | seeds=1-3). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/1942006790

Samir Patel: merged the kv-cache guard, tests passed. I'll trigger a staging smoke after Ryan's config lands. looks like the cache was returning old embeddings when prefix length changed.

Maria Gonzalez: ok thanks team. no other blockers from me. I'll collect regression examples into the shared doc (drive: /model-qc/llama3-smallq/regression-cases.md). :memo: 

Ana Li: quick Q — does anyone want me to add a short eval to check function-calling outputs? I saw one mismatch but could be unrelated.

Ryan Cho: yes please add it to the same job group, put function-calls in a separate bucket so we can diff semantics.

Maria Gonzalez: agree — separate bucket for function-call checks. otherwise :thumbsup: great cleanup.

Samir Patel: ping me if you see any reproducer logs. I'll keep an eye on staging cluster.

Maria Gonzalez: thanks — end of my update.
